purpose: Acquire missing process evidence; no algorithm development or source qualification in this protocol.
historical_record_policy: Preserve original draft, qualification reports, errors and counts; append new evidence in separate directories.

selected_source.scope: read-only identity binding, no qualification replay

operation_input_mappings.case_mapping_scope: exact mapping construction in retained probe script before validation/materialized auxiliaries; not an original saved plan hash
exact mapping construction in retained probe script before validation/materialized auxiliaries; not an original saved plan hash

original_execution.selection_rule: Use original nine-source subset and original paths; do not reindex a singleton or modify the case mapping.
original_execution.mapping_digest_scope: Reconstructed canonical pre-validation mappings, not original saved plans. JSON sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon, allow_nan=false.

future_execution_gates: Separate explicit approval of this finite replay is required; protocol freeze alone is not approval.
Freeze instrumented commit, patch SHA, unchanged business-code identities, dependency/environment manifest and all input/contract hashes before any replay.

Review observer-only diff and pass deterministic synthetic noninterference fixtures with observer off/hash_only/full_capture; include recorder failures and unchanged RNG, plans, results and exceptions.
Freeze exact comparison fields and any path/timestamp metadata exclusions before execution; no post-hoc normalization of input, contract, plan, mask or result differences.
Verify fresh output locations, finite storage reservation and evidence completeness limits before starting; never resume old qualification outputs.

arms_in_order.comparison: Compare both business results and retained diagnostic states/errors against original receipts. Original internal plans remain unavailable.
Exact business outputs and exception identity/text match A; collect ordered plans, allocations, masks and existing RNG-state digests.

arms_in_order.observer: same transcript plus detached raster/event capture
arms_in_order.comparison: Exact semantic transcript and business result match B, including ordered plans, allocations, mask and RNG digests.

finite_comparison_design.hardware: CPU only; no model generation calls
finite_comparison_design.runtime_identity: Capture Python, packages, platform, threads and all relevant inherited environment. Do not silently introduce a new PYTHONHASHSEED or reseed existing execution.
finite_comparison_design.timing_limit: Passive capture may change elapsed time. Observer-induced timeout or resource exhaustion invalidates diagnosis; never classify it as biological failure or increase budget after observing results.
finite_comparison_design.stop_rule: On any discrepancy, incomplete observer evidence, fault or timeout, stop subsequent arms and write mismatch_hold. Explain differences before interpreting a new result. No seed/anchor/parameter tuning or automatic retry.
finite_comparison_design.historical_equivalence_limit: A can compare only evidence actually retained in the old run. B versus C supplies new plan-level noninterference evidence; it cannot retrospectively establish original plan identity.

observer_noninterference_contract: Observer data and return values never enter candidate selection, sorting, allocations, anchor/interface preference, RNG or any pass/fail decision.
Observe already-computed values only. Never call planner, executor or guards a second time to obtain telemetry; mark unavailable and not_evaluated distinctly.
Copy arrays into detached storage before capture; never pass writable views or mutate live array flags, input dictionaries, cases, provenance, plans, results or exception payload/text.
Preserve original iteration order and lazy evaluation. Transcript event numbering uses a separate deterministic counter without random draws, UUIDs, reseeding or creation of random generators.

Read existing Python/NumPy/Torch/local-generator state without draws where present; do not initialize CUDA or import new execution backends solely for logging. Inventory inaccessible generators as unavailable, not matching.

Recorder faults, disk limits or queue failures must be caught outside business exception handling and cannot trigger replanning. Mark diagnosis invalid out of band; preserve original business behavior and do not silently drop evidence.
Diagnostic outputs never participate in business file discovery, resume, caches or qualification ledgers. No observer metadata is added to business objects.
Static review and equivalence evidence are required; absence of an observed mismatch alone is not proof of universal noninterference.
capture_requirements: Input file/content hashes, original reconstructed case mappings, contracts, code/diff/runtime identity and output inventory.
Every already-computed attempt in order: interface/anchor identities, preferences, allocations, replans and canonical ordered-plan digests.
Source/protected masks, legal envelopes, their unions, ownership masks/unions and existing reachability results; preserve dtype, shape, coordinate system and label semantics.
Desired/floor probes: requested and selected masks, failed target masks, before/after states, existing topology audits and per-interface realized contributions/deletion budgets.
Existing guard events with evaluated/not_evaluated status, event counts and unique rejected pixel sets where available; preserve intersections and repeated visits separately.
Structured exception feedback before the outer error-string collapse, without changing the exception.
Ordered semantic JSONL transcript plus lossless arrays and file/content SHA256 manifest. Nonfinite values receive explicit typed encodings; missing values remain null with reason, never zero.
Record unavailable telemetry explicitly. If planned evidence cannot be passively captured, report the gap and hold interpretation rather than adding counterfactual execution.
interpretation_rules: 70732 is topology-invalid, not safe area or a near-pass. 22287 is only the largest topology-passing floor trial retained for S07/U1, not a global optimum.
Do not attribute all failures to holes, raw-source fragmentation, anchor continuity or ownership without corresponding process evidence.
Aggregate preflight capacity minus trial area is not stagewise causal loss; repeated rejection events and overlapping masks cannot be summed into unique lost area.
An ownership partition can preserve union area while changing reachability; report these separately.
No disabling guards, changing mechanisms, exploring new anchors, changing budgets or tuning timeouts under this protocol.
Unexpected successful replay remains a diagnostic observation and does not amend old failures, add qualified patients or approve four targets.
Any later method research requires a separate frozen development/independent-validation patient split and cohort-exclusion audit.

outputs.collision_policy: Refuse pre-existing run directories; no overwrite or resume.
outputs.public_private_policy: Keep raw RGB, tissue/nuclei arrays and patient mappings private. Public summary contains hashed source references, code/input hashes, comparisons, limitations and approval status.
deliverables: static noninterference review and synthetic-fixture results
per-arm receipts/transcripts and private raster manifest
cross-arm comparison with mismatches or unavailable fields
